name: Ingoku no Yakata
source:
The ultimate immoral adventure game – combining extreme humiliation and sexual assault elements with the component of sexual slavery. Taking a remote western-styled mansion as the game’s stage, train these beautiful and lovely maids into your sex slaves!

Will you accept your fate, exhausting the limits of rape and sexual slavery? Or else, will you continue opposing those who hold you captive until the very end?

If you were to take a single step within this mansion, you too would end up becoming its prisoner…

[From [url=https://j-addicts.de/vn-of-the-month-december-2003/]j-addicts[/url]]
translation:
这是一款挑战道德底线的冒险游戏，将极端凌辱、性侵与性奴役等要素融为一体。故事发生在一座偏僻的西式宅邸中，你要把这些美丽可爱的女仆调教成自己的性奴。

你会接受命运，将强奸与性奴役贯彻到极致？还是坚持反抗囚禁自己的人，直至最后一刻？

一旦踏入这座宅邸，就连你也会沦为它的囚徒……

[摘自[url=https://j-addicts.de/vn-of-the-month-december-2003/]j-addicts[/url]]
